channel.title: Security Brief
channel.description: Original analysis and ranked cybersecurity news with links to original sources

item.title: The edge is where attackers get in: this week's firewall, VPN and remote-access exploits
item.description: Five exploited flaws in firewalls, VPNs, remote-support software and file-sharing servers show one pattern. The systems that sit at the edge of your network, and that administrators manage remotely, are the weakest link. Here is what to check first.

item.title: October 2026 Patch Tuesday: what the Microsoft feed shows and what to do
item.description: The Microsoft feed lists few entries, and most of them are updates to October's release rather than new fixes. The one item that needs planning is a .NET remote code execution flaw that Microsoft has not fixed yet. Identity Web and WSL need version checks if you use them.

item.title: Weekly M365 & Entra Briefing: 13 to 19 October 2026
item.description: Exchange sign-in problems after October Windows Server updates, an identity-based incident at ConnectWise that affected Microsoft 365 tenants, and why device-code abuse is still worth a Conditional Access check.

item.title: Hackers Exploit Critical VMware, Cisco, and Apache Flaws as Espionage Attacks Emerge
item.description: The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Friday added four flaws impacting Apache Roller, Cisco Expressway, SAP NetWeaver, and Broadcom VMware vCenter to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), citing evidence of active exploitation. The vulnerabilities are listed below - CVE-2026-129448…

item.title: N-able Discloses Critical Mail Assure Vulnerability Found During Breach Investigation
item.description: N-able yesterday disclosed a critical flaw it found while investigating the breach of its Mail Assure and SpamExperts Hosted Cloud, an email filtering service it runs for managed service providers. The bug, tracked as CVE-2026-134624, is a server-side request forgery (SSRF) flaw. It allowed a user with high-level API…

item.title: Critical Perforce Puppet RCE Exploited in Attacks
item.description: Tracked as CVE-2026-115731, it allows a client that holds any CA-signed agent certificate to execute code on the server. The post Critical Perforce Puppet RCE Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: China's 'Armory Castle' Lays Siege to VMware vCenter Zero-Day
item.description: During the last wave of major VMware vCenter security updates, a China-nexus threat group likely already had its next zero-day up its sleeve.

item.title: Hackers Exploit Critical ScreenConnect Flaw to Hijack MSP Technician PCs Without Warning
item.description: Threat actors are exploiting a now-patched security flaw in ConnectWise ScreenConnect to target managed service provider (MSP) servers. item.title: SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway Flaws Exploited in Attacks
item.description: Threat actors could exploit them to leak or modify server information and to execute commands as root. The post SAP NetWeaver, Cisco Expressway Flaws Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.description: Cybersecurity researchers have urged users to discontinue using a legacy ASP.NET anti-CSRF library named Idunno.AntiCsrf ("Idunno.AntiCsrf.dll") following the discovery of a critical vulnerability that has been exploited in the wild. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-131914, carries a CVSS score of 9.3 out of…

item.title: Five warning signs of ransomware breach before encryption or data theft
item.description: Ransomware attacks often involve credential theft, lateral movement, and attempts to disable security controls long before encryption begins. Acronis examines five warning signs that can help defenders detect intrusions earlier, contain malicious activity, and protect critical systems and backups.

item.title: Critical Apache Roller, Axis Vulnerabilities Exploited in Attacks
item.description: Attackers are targeting Confluence Data Center through an Axis flaw and Apache is warning of attacks against Roller. The post Critical Apache Roller, Axis Vulnerabilities Exploited in Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Apache warns of Roller RCE vulnerability exploited in attacks
item.description: Apache has released security updates to address a critical Roller flaw that threat actors are exploiting to gain code execution on vulnerable servers.

item.title: Norway says hackers exploited Microsoft security flaw to attack energy firms Equinor, Skagerak Energi
item.description: Norwegian energy companies Equinor and Skagerak Energi were affected by a Microsoft cloud security vulnerability that hackers have exploited to target sensitive credentials, Norway's cybersecurity authorities said.

item.title: SBC Medical Group Data Breach Impacts Over 2 Million
item.description: Threat actors accessed databases containing customer information associated with clinics in Japan. The post SBC Medical Group Data Breach Impacts Over 2 Million appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Everything Is a Web Application, Including Your Firewall
item.description: One of the early targets of PHP2Shell exploitation was the firewall. On October 28, Palo Alto Networks confirmed that attackers were exploiting the two PHP vulnerabilities, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, against PAN-OS management interfaces exposed to the internet. Both flaws let anyone execute code on the web…

item.title: Java4Shell Exploitation Attempts Begin as Vendors Rush Out Advisories
item.description: GreyNoise, WatchTowr and Cloudflare report probing and exploit attempts, while Cisco, Elastic, Red Hat and Siemens detail impact. The post Java4Shell Exploitation Attempts Begin as Vendors Rush Out Advisories appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Java4Shell Flaw (CVE-2026-114938) Enables Pre-Auth RCE in Jira, Jenkins, Keycloak and More
item.description: A Java flaw called Java4Shell can let attackers without an account run their own code on Jira, Jenkins, Keycloak, and three other widely used applications, says Calif, the security research firm that disclosed it this week. The flaw is present in Java 17.0.6 and later, and the vulnerable code runs only on x86-64 Intel…

item.title: Hackers breach Austrian Foreign Ministry website, access diplomats' contact details
item.description: Austria's Foreign Ministry said late last week that hackers breached one of its websites and accessed the names and official contact information of employees at its Vienna headquarters and at Austria’s diplomatic missions abroad.

item.title: Industrial Serial Gateways Broadcast That They're Insecure
item.description: Critical OT access devices will often tell you, and anyone else, whether they're protected by authentication — and many aren't.

item.title: South Korea’s power giant KEPCO confirms data breach impacting 1.5 million
item.description: A threat actor breached the internal network of Korea Electric Power Corporation (KEPCO) and accessed two systems containing customer, employee, and contractor data.

item.title: Microsoft Azure flaw exploited to steal customers' API credentials
item.description: Microsoft is warning customers that a security vulnerability in Azure API Management (APIM) Classic tiers was exploited to steal stored API credentials, with Norwegian authorities linking the flaw to cyberattacks against energy companies.

item.title: Spanish LaLiga confirms hackers stole soccer fans’ personal data
item.description: LaLiga, Spain's top men's football league, disclosed a data breach that exposed personal information belonging to users of its services and those of some affiliated clubs.

item.title: Signal blocks screenshots by Apple, Google operating systems to protect data from AI agents
item.description: Google’s Gemini Intelligence and Apple's Siri AI "are changing this environment in a way that’s making it increasingly hostile to privacy," Signal said.

item.title: FBI reportedly facing second data breach involving National Crime Information Center
item.description: The FBI is reportedly investigating a data breach involving the National Crime Information Center, a database used by U.S. law enforcement agencies that contains information on criminals, fugitives and missing people.

item.title: Behind the Alias: How One Researcher Unmasked a Decade of Ransomware Actors
item.description: Ransomware isn't slowing down. A new framework gives security teams the edge to trace attackers back to their source.

item.title: CrowdStrike to purchase Zscaler for $43.9 billion
item.description: “We see a path to become the largest AI safety and security company the world has ever seen,” CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz said.

item.title: Azure Flaw Exploited to Target Secrets at Norwegian Energy Firms
item.description: Microsoft closed an Azure API Management flaw exploited to target secrets at Norwegian energy companies, with other sectors also affected. The post Azure Flaw Exploited to Target Secrets at Norwegian Energy Firms appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: N-able Patches Critical Flaw Discovered After Mail Assure Cyberattack
item.description: The company has restored access to the affected services and continues to monitor the affected environments. The post N-able Patches Critical Flaw Discovered After Mail Assure Cyberattack appeared first on SecurityWeek.

item.title: Microsoft testing fix for Windows 11 Bluetooth audio quality drops
item.description: Microsoft is working to fix a long-standing Windows issue that has been causing significant audio quality drops for Bluetooth headphone users.

item.title: Microsoft confirms Windows printing issues affecting Forcepoint users
item.description: Microsoft confirmed printing issues on systems running Forcepoint DLP software after installing the KB5132043 November 2026 Windows 11 hotpatch.

item.description: Hackers exploited a vulnerability in GL.iNet's GoodCloud remote management service to install malware on some customer routers and KVM devices, the maker of travel routers and remote-access KVM hardware said in a security notice updated today. The company identified and fixed the flaw on Friday and blocked the access…

item.title: Microsoft Entra Connect Health flaw exploited to steal tenant data
item.description: Microsoft is warning organizations that it suffered a data breach after attackers exploited a vulnerability in its Entra Connect Health service to gain unauthorized access to administrator email addresses and tenant configuration information.
